content.short: HypurrFi is a HyperEVM lending protocol for borrowing against holdings and earning yield.
content.description: HypurrFi combines lending, perpetuals trading and a credit card on Hyperliquid. Users supply assets to lending markets and automated vaults to earn interest across major tokens, stablecoins and long-tail assets, then borrow against that collateral and spend with the card without selling. Trading covers crypto and Bitcoin perpetuals and spot alongside gold and tokenized equities. The protocol also offers issuers protocol-owned liquidity and credit rails to build out a new token, RWA or stablecoin across DEX pools and lending markets.
content.meta: Borrow against holdings on HyperEVM, with a simple entry into more advanced positions.
